title: Action registry
description: The micro-action vocabulary, as defined in The Software Field Guide, issue #70: named, typed, parameter-checked actions with enforced execution envelopes, security classifications, confirmation demands, effects, and — for external calls — a registered, approved server with argument mappings. This schema mirrors the shape rules of the Rego validator (policies/actions); the validator additionally enforces the semantic rules a JSON schema cannot — action ids unique, parameter names unique per action, parameters carrying both a known type and a validation object (enumValues, when declared, a non-empty array), envelopes inside the platform ceilings and declaring isolation, confirmation pinned to the severity classification (a High or Critical write must demand confirm, never auto-confirm), external calls naming an operation, a known and approved registered server with a mapping for every parameter, and reviews not older than 365 days nor in the future.

version.description: Version of the registry. The vocabulary is versioned like code — an action set that can silently change is folklore, not a registry.

reviewedOn.description: Date the registry was last reviewed, YYYY-MM-DD. The validator flags reviews older than 365 days and dates in the future.

maxTimeoutSeconds.description: The most wall clock any single action may hold, in seconds. Every envelope is judged against this ceiling — an action cannot grant itself more time than the host is willing to give any action.

maxMemoryMB.description: The most memory any single action may hold, in MB. Every envelope is judged against this ceiling.

servers.description: The registered external servers an action may call. A server may be registered but unapproved — it must then be referenced by nothing.

name.description: Server name. Unique across the registry; external actions reference it.

approved.description: Whether the server has been approved for production calls. An external action naming an unapproved server does not ship.

actions.description: The micro-actions. Each is named, typed, parameter-checked, envelope-bound, classified, and confirmed — the whole anatomy, or it is not an action.

id.description: Action id. Unique across the registry; the agent manifest grants it verbatim.

name.description: The action's human name. An action nobody can name is an action nobody can scope.

description.description: What the action does, in terms you are willing to say out loud.

type.description: The execution family. Closed vocabulary: a type nobody executes is a finding, not an action.

parameters.description: The action's parameters, each with a name, a known type, and a validation object. The declared checks are what the engine enforces — a schema without checks is documentation, not validation.

name.description: Parameter name. Unique within the action; argument scopes constrain it by this name.

type.description: The parameter's type. Closed vocabulary. An untyped parameter cannot be checked, only stringly-trusted.

validation.description: The checks the engine enforces at call time. enumValues, when declared, must be a non-empty array of allowed values.

outputs.description: The action's declared outputs, as name-to-type pairs. An action that returns nothing has no contract with its caller.

timeoutSeconds.description: The action's time budget. Must not exceed platformCeilings.maxTimeoutSeconds.

maxMemoryMB.description: The action's memory budget. Must not exceed platformCeilings.maxMemoryMB.

useIsolation.description: Whether the action runs in isolation. A scripted action without isolation is a guest with the house keys.

securityLevel.description: The action's severity classification, from the closed ladder.

confirmation.description: Whether a human must confirm before the action fires. A High or Critical action that auto-confirms is exactly how a blast radius grows one PR at a time.

effect.description: What the action does to the estate. A read-only agent granted a write contradicts its stage.

name.description: The registered server this action calls. Must be declared and approved in this registry.

operation.description: The operation invoked on the server. An external call without an operation is a hope, not a call.

mappings.description: Parameter-to-argument mappings for the call. Every declared parameter must be mapped.

server.description: Required for ExternalServer actions; forbidden vocabulary for the others.
